strokes.text: Installs one OBS plugin from a manifest that pins every file by SHA-256, and records the installation in state.
Planning and refreshing only inspect the installed files; the install itself happens on apply and requires OBS to be closed.
Destroying the resource forgets the installation and leaves the plugin files in place.
Declaring a plugin turns a missing or altered installation into a visible plan change instead of a failure when a source or filter first needs it.
The installer currently supports macOS only, and `install_dir` defaults to the per-user OBS plugin folder on macOS.
OBS loads plugins only at startup, so a new plugin is not usable in the apply that installs it.
With OBS closed, apply a configuration that contains only `obs_plugin` resources.
Start OBS, then apply the scenes, sources and filters that use the plugin.
Keep the plugin resources in their own root module, because scene resources cannot be refreshed while OBS is closed.

glazes.install_dir: Directory that receives the plugin. Defaults to the per-user OBS plugin folder on macOS. Changing it replaces the resource.
glazes.manifest_sha256: SHA-256 of the manifest file, as 64 hexadecimal characters. The install is refused when the file does not match.
glazes.plugin_id: Identifier of the plugin entry in the manifest. Changing it replaces the resource.
glazes.version: Plugin version the configuration was written against. It must equal the version in the manifest entry.
